Vietnamese and English Combine!
Jan 2016 • Friends
I volunteered some of my time at Tipi Cafe as a native-English speaker. It was a fabulous time! Not only is it super beneficial to the locals to practice their English, but it is also super beneficial for the foreigner to gain insights on the best places to eat, fun things to do, or travel recommendations around Da Nang! 

We share our language and they share their city and culture! Plus, the people are so warm and welcoming you'll probably make a few friends out of it too! We shared some time at the beach with the locals we met at the cafe.

The drinks are good and fair priced. Everything is fresh and homemade right down the to whipped cream they put on your smoothie or latte.

Also, check the Facebook page for fun event nights like game show night, karaoke night, acoustic night, and talk show night! Lots happening at this beautiful gem!

Beautiful drinks, Amazing people!
Jun 2015 • Friends
My partner and i just spent 2 weeks in Da Nang, mainly at this cafe! (No food is served here hence my lack of rating on the food department.

I am a foodie and he is a drinkie? (Barman/Cocktail artist always looking for new drinks and tips. Not an alcoholic!)

If you would like to meet some genuine incredible vietnamese people then this is a Cafe to visit. Their drip coffee is of course amazing but the ideas they have come up with for fresh fruit smoothies and iced teas and coffees blew me away. 

So the experience... You can arrive here being an english speaker wanting to share your language in return for some ideas on the go to places, or a vietnamese speraker wanting to practise your english and meet some new friends. What time to go to the beach, where to each vegetarian, where to try the crazy duck and fish sauce local delicacies... I will let you figure them out for yourselves!! These are all things i gained just from being there.

The manager is a saint and will help you however possible. We even borrowed his motorbike to go out for lunch!

You will often find other western tourist / volunteers as they are a host on Workaway.com to chat to and go out with. 

The highlight for my partner and i was the genuinly selfless generous ( I cannot stress this enough!!) Students and staff that i ended up becoming very good friends with, the things we were shown and taught are things that money cannot buy and i will treasure forever. 

Thankyou Tipi for showing me what DaNang is really about!
